extracted.summary: A solicitor asks whether funding of £34,000 for disbursements and counsel is available for a client's personal injury claim arising from a road traffic accident.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry and for the details provided so far. To consider it further we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction in which the claim is proceeding, the current stage of proceedings and any listed hearing dates, the claim's valuation and any supporting documentation, and details of any existing funding or insurance arrangements. Please note we specialise in family law and probate matters, so we will need to review whether this type of case falls within our scope. Once we have that information a colleague will review the enquiry and come back to you. Nothing in this message should be taken as any indication of whether funding can be offered.
